summary: Completed comprehensive testing of notifications feature (GET /api/notifications, POST /api/notifications/seen, /notifications page with tabs, filtering, navigation, New/Earlier split, bell dot). All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend page renders properly with all 5 tabs, filtering works, navigation to /likes and /chats works, empty state displays correctly, layout responsive at 393x852 and 393x660. Regression tests passed: toasts still work (dark bottom bar), profile page fits, no horizontal overflow, rapid tab switching works.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/notifications returns items, seen_at, unseen_count with correct structure
Backend: POST /api/notifications/seen marks notifications as seen
Backend: Unauthenticated GET /api/notifications returns 401
Backend: unseen_count becomes 0 after marking seen
Backend: Items sorted newest first
Backend: Notification types include like, superlike, match, message (system notices timed from account creation)
Frontend: Bell button on /profile navigates to /notifications
Frontend: Page renders header 'Notifications' with back button
Frontend: All 5 tabs present and clickable (All, Likes, Matches, Messages, System)
Frontend: Notification rows display with avatars, color-coded badges (pink heart like, purple star superlike, green bubble message, blue people match), titles, subtitles, time, chevron
Frontend: Tab filtering works correctly (Likes shows like+superlike, Matches shows match, Messages shows message, System shows system, All shows everything)
Frontend: Empty state displays 'You're all caught up' with bell icon when no notifications in tab
Frontend: Earlier group displays notifications correctly
Frontend: Like notification navigates to /likes
Frontend: Message notification navigates to /chats/{id}
Frontend: Back button returns to previous page
Frontend: Bell dot not visible when unseen_count is 0
Frontend: Layout works at 393x852 viewport
Frontend: Layout works at 393x660 viewport
Frontend: No horizontal overflow
Frontend: Text truncation works (single-line titles/subtitles)
Frontend: Time labels show relative time (e.g., '11m ago', '2h ago')
Frontend: Rapid tab switching works without blank screens
Frontend: No console errors
Regression: Toasts still work (dark bottom bar appears for VOILADI+ click)
Regression: Profile page still fits with all elements visible
Regression: Profile stats, features, menu sections all render correctly
